description: ADR-0029 — submit a did:etzhayyim op (create | update | deactivate). For 'create', the server verifies CID(op) matches the last segment of did. The op is persisted to vertex_etzhayyim_op_log and the identity row is upserted into vertex_etzhayyim_identity.

did.description: Target did:etzhayyim. For create the did MUST equal parent_did + ':' + CID(op). For update/deactivate the did MUST already exist.

op.description: Canonical genesis / update / deactivate op body (JSON mirror of the DAG-CBOR encoded op). Must contain v=1, type, parent, segment, vm, alsoKnownAs, service, createdAt per ADR-0029.

prev.description: CID of previous op (required for update/deactivate)

sig.description: Signature over CID(op), base64url. Required for update/deactivate; optional for create (genesis is self-attesting via CID).

sigKid.description: verificationMethod id used to sign (required when sig is present)

errors.name: CidMismatch
errors.description: CID(op) does not match DID last segment (create) or prev_cid chain (update)

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: op already exists or out-of-order seq
